tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
to confine, besiege
Another spelling of tsur (צוּר "to confine" H6696A)

1) to bind, be narrow, be in distress, make narrow, cause distress, besiege, be straitened, be bound
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to bind, tie up, shut up
1a2) to be scant, be cramped, be in straits
1b) (Pual) to be bound, be tied up
1c) (Hiphil)
1c1) to make narrow for, cause distress to, press hard upon

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive
strongs_1890.kjv_def: adversary, (be in) afflict(-ion), beseige, bind (up), (be in, bring) distress, enemy, narrower, oppress, pangs, shut up, be in a strait (trouble), vex.
